questions.question: Whom did Nehemiah put in charge of Jerusalem because of his faithfulness and fear of God?
What did Nehemiah find to register the people?
options: A detailed map of the newly rebuilt city walls
The old tax records kept by the whole province
A fresh new census of the people taken house by house
The book of the genealogy of those who came up first
questions.answer: The book of the genealogy of those who came up first

questions.question: Nehemiah commanded that the gates not be opened until the sun was hot, for security.
